senses.gloss:
√kḷp (kálpate; cākḷpé [786]; kalpsyáte;
kḷptá; kalpáyati, -te). be in order; be
suitable or serviccable to; help; kḷptá,
in order, fixed, settled; --caus. put in
order; ordain; arrange; dispose; fix (in
the manifold applications of this word as
used colloquially). [prob. not akin are
Goth. hilpan, Eng. help.]
+ upa, caus. prepare; furnish; provide.
+ sam, caus. arrange together; determine;
 will; purpose.

kḷpta-keśanakhaśmaśru, a. having hair
and nails and beard in order, i. e. trimmed.
[keśa-nakha-śmaśru, 1252.]

kḷptānta, having its end prescribed;
limited. [anta.]
